modes.description: Words such as usual, previously, effective, or daily that refer back to a habitual dose or earlier exposure.

card.writes: It suppresses words like recurrent, repeated and repeatedly, so it lowers the chance of the next word being about repetition.
card.plain: It marks spots where regular or repeated use is already clear, so repeat words are less likely to come next.
